title: Sri Vinayagar Vijayam
desc: Follow the life and incredible story of Lord Ganesha from his childhood to his divinity, recounting famous mythological events that lead to his rise as a revered deity and remover of obstacles.

title: Rasukutti
desc: Rasukutty, an uneducated man, lies to his fiancée Rukmani that he is a lawyer. However, after Rukmani learns the truth, she breaks her engagement with him and starts hating him.

title: Captain Prabhakar
desc: Prabhakaran, a forest officer, is assigned to arrest the notorious smuggler Veerabhadran. While duty calls, Prabhakaran also decides to avenge his friend's death.

title: Ullathai Allitha
desc: Tired of his father's disciplinarian ways and to avoid marrying a girl chosen by the latter, Raja runs away to Ooty. There, he is hired as a driver by the man whose daughter he was supposed to marry.

title: Sivakaasi
desc: Muthappa is forced to leave his house at a young age for a crime that his older brother, Udayappa, committed. When he returns home, he learns about his brother's antics and decides to punish him.
